definitions.provider: Provider whose plan was observed. PGP is the compiler; it is not inserted as a patient quote without matching evidence.
definitions.plan_name: Concise selected-term label. Full source description, exact selected total and period qualifications are retained in quote-detail.
definitions.medication_type: Compounded or Brand when established; null when formulation class is unverified. This is not route.
definitions.medication_name: Provider medication/product name; no equivalence claim across formulations.
definitions.membership_fee_monthly_usd: Separately required monthly membership when verified. Unknown is null, never automatically zero.
definitions.medication_cost_monthly_usd: Quoted medication-plan bundle total divided by source-labelled plan months, rounded to cents. Can include bundled services. Calendar-month duration is not assumed; see quote-detail.
definitions.total_effective_monthly_usd: Known quoted plan-month medication bundle plus separately required membership, when both are established. Same source-labelled month basis as medication_cost. An explicit whole-program monthly quote can establish this total even when its membership allocation is unknown. Otherwise unknown membership gives null. Final tax/card charge remains unverified.
definitions.plan_length_months: Source-labelled selected plan months only. Native week/day plans remain null here; exact supply weeks/days and billing cadence remain in detail.
definitions.states_served: Categorical string: numeric state count from a matched product public claim, or Not verified (product-specific). Provider-wide counts are shown separately in Provider checks and must not imply every treatment ships everywhere. Typed counts/null remain in quote-detail.
definitions.pharmacy_named_publicly: Categorical string: Yes with actual publicly named provider-network partners, No only if established, or Not established in reviewed sources. A public network name does not identify the pharmacy assigned to a selected prescription.
definitions.legitscript_certified: Yes/No only for a current independent verification result; otherwise Not independently verified. Provider self-claims are separate. An inaccessible directory is not a negative result.
definitions.fda_approved_medication: Yes/No for the specific finished formulation, otherwise Not verified. Verified compounded drugs are No; named brand approval requires product-specific evidence. Typed boolean/null and sources remain in quote-detail and product-metadata.
definitions.insurance_accepted: Yes/No/Not verified for whether insurance applies to the listed cash quote. This does not state company-wide acceptance, outside reimbursement, local-pharmacy billing or HSA/FSA eligibility; those policy distinctions are preserved separately.
definitions.source_url: Official session-free price-flow URL; login or intake may be required. Screenshots support otherwise nonpublic prices.
definitions.date_collected: Actual price-observation date; background metadata has a separate checked-on date. Prior collection times were not invented.

metadata_representation: Cora-compatible categorical strings with explicit unknown markers; original typed boolean/count/null facts, field-level status/reason/source IDs and separate checked-on dates are preserved in quote-detail and product-metadata.

pgp_mapping.total_effective_monthly_usd: same configured plan-bundle monthly rate, not a verified final charge
pgp_mapping.membership_fee_monthly_usd: null; no separately identified membership allocation in benchmark
pgp_mapping.plan_length_months: configured billing interval months, not proof of dispensed supply
pgp_mapping.source_url: exact benchmark evidence reference; no invented public product URL

combined_view.evidence_class_warning: The 96 observed quotes and 32 owner-configured plans are different evidence classes, explicitly labelled per row.

certification_provenance: Publisher-confirmed: the publisher read the LegitScript checker directly on 2026-10-20 and confirmed certification. Automated retrieval was bot-gated; this is not represented as an automated directory result.
